about: Intentional stdout/stderr/exit-code differences between the published reference build and the current build. One entry per (case, field); every entry needs a reason. An entry that no longer differs fails the run, so this list cannot rot. Empty by default: new differences are regressions, not allowlist material.

entries.reason: wnice --help documents the new read-only --jobs view and the opt-in --no-servers environment settings; the pinned 0.4.0 reference predates these additions. No other case, field, message or exit code differs.
admin --help documents the new opt-in --keep-limits flag; the pinned 0.4.0 reference predates it. No other case, field, message or exit code differs.
